scope: One aggregate14 source-only diagnostic correction; no install, provider, gameplay, newRoot or source13 mutation.

checks.predicate: action_kind != context AND (context_basis != none OR basis_source_id != null OR basis_quote != null)
context action, non-none basis, quote not nonempty JS text OR UTF16 length >240
material basis and source != director_context OR no exact quote containment in planned director_notes/public_fact/private_note
other non-none basis and source absent OR kind not role/fato OR no exact quote containment in source body
context action, none basis, source or quote nonnull

producer.insertion: At each existing throw, mint the same Error with private WeakMap association to same work and closed diagnostic; no replaced predicate/order/accepted values.
producer.catch_gate: Only exact internally minted Error identity AND same work object; no provider-supplied property/message alone may mint diagnostic. Existing error.message/failure_codes/status remain unchanged.
producer.fall_silent: Diagnostic construction failure omits diagnostic and preserves original Error and original catch/accounting behavior.

closed_shape.basis_quote_utf16_length: nonnegative safe integer if string else null
closed_shape.basis_quote_utf8_bytes: nonnegative safe integer if string else null

metadata_rules: Exact listed keys only; no arbitrary object spreads from provider or work.
No role text, quote content, source ID, actor ID, raw provider response, token, secret, freeform reason or message.
context_basis is already validated enum; action kind reduced to boolean, not emitted arbitrary opportunity action.
Only PLANNED_LITERAL_BINDING computes planned literal match type in original director_notes/public_fact/private_note order; null outside that check, none when no match.
Only SOURCE_LITERAL_BINDING computes exact body containment of existing role/fato source; null outside eligible diagnostic checks.
Source kind maps only role/fato/other/absent; sizes are scalar metadata, never truncations or normalized quote replacements.
No extra source or quote hashes needed: existing envelope work/request/payload/raw/result hashes already bind diagnostic.

delivery.location: failed private result only; absent on success and unrelated failure
delivery.serialization: Existing canonical delivery hash after optional diagnostic insertion, then unchanged db.finalize path.
delivery.cap_rule: Append only if the complete resulting delivery fits existing65536byte cap; otherwise omit only diagnostic. Preserve original overflow guard, failure and accounting behavior.
delivery.publication: No new client/DTO/status/SQL fields; work_status projects9technicalfields and does not expose work.result.

db.reason: Current finalizer validates binding/usage without top-level result key allowlist, then stores entire p_result and corresponding hash. No SQL guard needs relaxing.
db.scope_limit: Catalog proof covers named finalizer, named status projector and direct table/schema ACL. It is not an exhaustive proof of every administrative reader.

invariants: No validator/semantic/model prompt/Count schema/Gen schema change
failure_codes array unchanged, no added tag there
No public diagnostics or new API fields
future_installation_blocker: Live recovery is bound to reviewed Edge tuple8/11. Future diagnostic14 bundle is not thereby authorized or covered: current mandate source+review only, any future install/run needs explicit integrated composition/recovery/Root qualification; no claim abort coverage for uninstalled14.
checks_permitted: Source AST/diff/syntax/data-shape projection only, no application import/execution, fixtures, provider, DBmutations or gameplay.
